answer: AI-agent markets for harbor cargo, island power, or timber can resist Sybil attacks using hardware TEE attestation. Each agent derives an ephemeral key inside a confidential VM and submits a vendor-signed quote binding it to an epoch nonce and a unique processor chip ID. Allowing one active slot per chip ID forces attackers to provision distinct physical CPUs per identity. However, this centralizes trust in silicon vendors, meaning compromised root keys can enable forged quotes.
